title: External systems and anti-corruption integration boundaries
flow: Validate institution entitlement and external endpoint configuration
Send authorized request with stable correlation and idempotency identifiers
Retain safe request/response provenance under data minimization policy
Translate external statuses through versioned anti-corruption adapter
Mark ambiguous outcomes unresolved pending reconciliation
Escalate mismatches with operator review and full audit chain
rules: Never equate external message acknowledgement with settled funds
Do not embed an external provider's status model directly into core ledger posting rules
Version adapters and preserve the raw-response evidence needed for audit
Require secure mutual identity/signing policy from the actual participant contract
Only sanctioned external reference values may be retained in customer records
Keep remote outage from causing an automatic duplicated financial command
test_cases: Reject an adapter schema version not approved for that participant
External timeout creates explicit unknown outcome without reposting
Retry same external correlation does not create two internal effects
Cross-institution adapter credentials cannot be used
Malformed external status never passes as settlement evidence
approval_gate: Institution-specific contracts, message/profile versions, security credentials and qualified payments/legal review.
